sar.narrative: On 1970-01-18 at 03:02:40, card C07297-K1 held by customer C07297 was used for a online transaction of $482.12 in billing region 264.0. The cardholder reported the purchase as unauthorised in the customer_report trigger for case HHG-006, stating they did not make it. It arrived from device profile DP-06b586604af20226, recorded as New and serving 543 card(s) across 543 customer(s). Card C07297-K1 already had 5 online authorisation(s) in the preceding 48 hours. The purchase itself is outside the cardholder's normal profile: $482.12 against a card median of $62.93. Device profile DP-06b586604af20226 also appears on confirmed-fraud case(s) CC-0005, CC-0006, CC-0018 involving other cards, indicating a common actor. Card(s) C00094-K3, C00118-K1, C00134-K1, C00149-K1 share that device profile and are placed under monitoring. The activity is assessed as card not present new device under policy R6. Total unauthorised amount across 5 transaction(s) is $1956.08 between 1970-01-17 and 1970-01-18. Card C07297-K1 is recommended for blocking and reissue, an internal case is opened, and the report awaits fraud-manager approval.
